268105: Eight people experience a strange phenomenon while waiting for a bus at a remote station on a rainy October night.

362105: Teenage friends must resist the spell of an evil showman staging a house of horrors show in their small town.

467405: After moving into a cottage together, two young lovers confront horrors of a forgotten childhood.
